info.title: Platform subscription oversight and boundary cancellation

get.description: Requires current Platform context, recent administrator AAL2 and platform.subscription.read. Returns control-owned commercial metadata only; no tenant database, provider call, payment or aggregate total. Cursor pages use ascending subscription ID; no total count is asserted.

200.description: At most 50 subscription rows and optional next cursor; read is audited

get.summary: Audit a control-owned tenant subscription term
get.description: Requires Platform context, recent administrator AAL2 and platform.subscription.read. No tenant-scoped subscription authority or tenant database access. A tenant without a current term returns not found.

200.description: Control subscription state and current term

post.summary: Schedule subscription cancellation at term boundary
post.description: Requires platform.subscription.manage, current Platform context, recent AAL2, optimistic version and idempotency. Atomic subscription state, transition, command, audit and outbox. Does not settle, refund or call a provider.

200.description: Boundary cancellation scheduled or idempotent receipt

409.description: Stale version or invalid lifecycle state

post.summary: Withdraw a scheduled cancellation before its boundary
post.description: Requires platform.subscription.manage, current Platform context, recent AAL2, optimistic version and idempotency. Does not settle, refund or call a provider.

200.description: Boundary cancellation withdrawn or idempotent receipt

409.description: Stale version or invalid lifecycle state
